title: RLN Music Presents: Elkie Brooks
venue: The De La Warr Pavilion, Bexhill
summary: Elkie Brooks performs her 'Long Farewell Tour' live in concert, celebrating 65 years of music with hits and material from her new album.

title: Rye Market
summary: A weekly market with a large range of stalls, open all year round. Come down to support local trading and small businesses.

title: Henry V by William Shakespeare
summary: A theatre production of Shakespeare's history play, following King Henry's invasion of France and the Battle of Agincourt. The performance takes place inside the Tudor Rooms with allocated seating.

title: Christmas at Bodiam Castle
summary: Enjoy a winter walk with hot chocolate, write to Father Christmas and take a photo in his sleigh. Explore decorated trees and a festive trail, or book a Christmas lunch at the Wharf tea-room.

title: Charles Barnett comic singer songwriter
summary: Charles Barnett performs a full evening of live music, laughs and feel-good entertainment at The Chapel, featuring classic singalong favourites and original songs.
